boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten map-listed destinations on nearby Elmhurst corridors, each paired with one practical, sourced reason to go.

cards.title: See Elmhurst Through the Glos Mansion
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue, just east of York Street
cards.notes: Walk east from York Street to explore local history inside the Glos Mansion; check the museum’s posted schedule before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A downtown mansion housing exhibits and archives about Elmhurst’s past.
cards.evidence_claim: The city-operated Elmhurst History Museum is at 120 E. Park Avenue in the Glos Mansion, one-half block east of York Street, and presents exhibits supported by its collections and archives.
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday and Tuesday–Friday 1–5 p.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; generally closed Monday and listed holidays.

cards.title: Pause for Coffee Beside the Tracks
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue west of York Street
cards.notes: Use this Park Avenue stop for coffee or pastries near the station; order ahead if you are fitting the visit between trains or classes.
cards.short_summary: A compact café stop on the station-side stretch of Park Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Brewpoint identifies Founder's Cafe at 124 W. Park Avenue and lists coffee and pastries among its offerings.
cards.access_notes: The business lists Monday–Friday hours of 6:30 a.m.–7 p.m. and weekend hours of 7 a.m.–7 p.m.

cards.title: Catch the UP-West Line
cards.subtitle: First Street at York Road
cards.notes: Enter from First Street for a rail trip toward Chicago or Elburn, and consult Metra’s current schedule before choosing a departure.
cards.short_summary: The downtown rail connection for trips east or west on Metra.
cards.evidence_claim: Metra’s Union Pacific West line information lists Elmhurst station at 128 W. First Street, at York Road.
cards.source_title: Union Pacific West Line Schedule and Connecting Services | Metra
cards.access_notes: Train service requires a valid fare; verify the current timetable and platform information with Metra before travel.

cards.title: Choose a Movie on York Street
cards.subtitle: North York Street in downtown Elmhurst
cards.notes: Check the day’s listings, reserve a seat, and make this restored ten-screen theater the single entertainment reason for walking downtown.
cards.short_summary: A restored downtown cinema with ten screens and modern projection.
cards.evidence_claim: Classic Cinemas lists York Theatre at 150 N. York Street and describes it as a restored historic theater with ten screens, recliner seating and digital projection.
cards.access_notes: Admission is ticketed. For R-rated films, guests under 17 require an accompanying parent or guardian age 21 or older.

cards.title: Sit Down for Brunch or Dinner
cards.subtitle: North York Street near downtown dining
cards.notes: Use this York Street address for a full sit-down meal; review the current menu and kitchen-closing time before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant serving brunch, lunch and dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Modern Plate’s official site places the restaurant at 119 N. York Street and states that it serves brunch, lunch and dinner.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours vary by day; the official page separately identifies kitchen-closing times.

cards.title: Take York Road for Breakfast
cards.subtitle: North York Road above the downtown core
cards.notes: Head north on York Road for a daytime breakfast or lunch stop, confirming the café’s temporary hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A daytime café option on the northward York Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Rainbow Cafe’s official contact page lists its location as 254 N. York Road in Elmhurst.
cards.access_notes: The café currently posts temporary hours of 7 a.m.–3 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Turn onto Cottage Hill for Art
cards.subtitle: Cottage Hill Avenue at the north end of Wilder Park
cards.notes: Walk Cottage Hill Avenue to the museum for its current exhibitions, checking admission details and Wednesday–Sunday hours first.
cards.short_summary: A museum destination connecting contemporary art, architecture and Wilder Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst Art Museum lists its address as 150 Cottage Hill Avenue and says it stands at the north end of Wilder Park beside the public library.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists hours of noon–5 p.m. Wednesday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–5 p.m. Friday–Sunday; closed Monday–Tuesday.

cards.title: Use Prospect Avenue for Library Time
cards.subtitle: South Prospect Avenue beside Wilder Park
cards.notes: Bring study materials to Prospect Avenue and use the library’s public spaces; review room rules or card requirements for specific services.
cards.short_summary: A municipal library with study rooms, collections and a virtual floor tour.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst Public Library’s official visitor page gives its address as 125 S. Prospect Avenue and describes an 80,000-square-foot building with reservable study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–9 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m.; some services may require a library card.

cards.title: Follow Prospect Avenue to a Park Loop
cards.subtitle: South Prospect Avenue through the Wilder Park campus
cards.notes: Enter from Prospect Avenue for a walk using the park’s paths, then choose among the playground, tennis courts or picnic area.
cards.short_summary: A 17-acre civic park with paths, gardens, recreation and cultural neighbors.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst Park District places Wilder Park at 175 S. Prospect Avenue and lists walking paths, a running trail, tennis courts, a playground and picnic space.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor amenities are subject to park rules, weather and any posted closures.

cards.title: Continue South for Seasonal Flowers
cards.subtitle: South Prospect Avenue at the conservatory block
cards.notes: Continue down Prospect Avenue for the current flower display; follow visitor rules and arrange permits before any posed photography.
cards.short_summary: A year-round public conservatory presenting rotating seasonal flower shows.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst Park District lists Wilder Park Conservatory at 225 S. Prospect Avenue and states that it is free, open year-round and hosts three seasonal flower shows.
cards.source_title: Wilder Park Conservatory | Elmhurst Park District
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 8 a.m.–6 p.m. April–December and 8 a.m.–2:30 p.m. January–March; check for weather or show-installation closures.
